goal:
Server evidence chain with stage drilldown
WHY: Judging Whether-it-works needs per-edge event_id drilldown without hiding missing evidence; current GET /v1/evidence/{id} is a flat dict so the Evidence Timeline can never resolve stages (roadmap D2-3 Evidence).

SPEC: New services/api/evoforge/evidence.py: record(kind,payload)->event_id (ev_<12hex>, unique), link(evidence_id, stage, event_id) append-only, chain(evidence_id)->[{stage,event_id}] for stages ObjectiveVersion,Task,Candidate,Gate,Review,PR,Outcome (match apps/web EVIDENCE_STAGES). Wire into services/api/main.py: /v1/commands/generate links Task+Candidate+Gate; /v1/objectives links ObjectiveVersion; /v1/candidates/review links Review; /v1/runs links Candidate+Gate (+run base); /v1/pr/create links PR and preserves source_evidence_id link. GET /v1/evidence/{id} returns {id, chain, data:<existing payload>}; missing stages get event_id null (never fabricated); unknown id -> 404. Invariants: chain append-only; chain entries are ids only (no held-out code in chain); existing response fields unchanged.
Critic constraint (existing tests read these): GET /v1/evidence/{id} must keep every existing payload field at the top level (e.g. diff, tests, gates, run, source_evidence_id, pr) and ADD "chain" and "data" alongside them. Chain order must equal apps/web EVIDENCE_STAGES.

ACCEPTANCE (your own plan): POST generate then GET evidence shows non-null Task/Candidate/Gate and null Review/PR/Outcome (증거 부족), not 404; POST /v1/runs then /v1/pr/create chain preserves source_evidence_id link and PR stage resolves; GET unknown evidence id -> 404; held-out secret marker never appears in chain or GET body repr; python -m pytest services/api -q passes
OUT OF SCOPE: services/api/evoforge/postgres_kernel.py; services/api/evoforge/kernel_api.py (do not create); ledger math / gate verdict rules; web UI changes
